item.name: Add an item (JSON, or form-data with an image file)

request.description:
**Permission:** reading is open to any signed-in user; this change needs `inventory`.

Send **multipart/form-data** to upload a picture: field `image` = the file (JPG, PNG, WEBP or GIF, max 5 MB), `specs` = a JSON string, all other fields as text. The saved `image` is a path like `/uploads/items/1731.jpg` — show it as `<server>/uploads/items/1731.jpg`. Plain JSON still works.

**Permission:** reading is open to any signed-in user; this change needs `inventory`.

item.name: ★ All form data in one call (recommended for the app)

query.description: Optional — return only this category (any letter case)

request.description:
**Permission:** any signed-in user.

Returns an **array** — one object per category, each containing only its own data:

`name` → Category dropdown · `brands` → Brand dropdown (`brandInput` = `text` means no list, show a text box) · `subCategories[].name` → Sub-category dropdown · `subCategories[].fields` → the inputs to show for that sub-category (`input` = `dropdown` uses `options`, or `text` / `number`).

Add `?category=Keyboard` to get just that one category (still an array with 1 object).

Tip: call it when the app starts and keep the result; call again only to refresh (the server answers **304 Not Modified** when nothing changed if the app sends the `If-None-Match` ETag).

**Permission:** any signed-in user.

Names only, in display order. Use `name` in step 2.

item.name: Step 2 & 3 — Sub-categories, brands and spec fields for a category

query.description: Category name (any letter case), e.g. Camera
Optional — the chosen sub-category, e.g. CCTV

request.description:
**Permission:** any signed-in user.

Call with `category` after the user picks a category → fill the **Sub-category** dropdown from `subCategories` and the **Brand** dropdown from `brands` (if `brandInput` is `text`, show a text box).

Call again with `subCategory` after the user picks one → `fields` then holds only the inputs for that sub-category. Show one input per field: `input` = `dropdown` (use `options`), `text` or `number`.

Save: `POST /api/items` with `category`, `subCategory`, `brand`, `name`, `totalQuantity` and `specs` = `specsTemplate` filled in.

Without `subCategory`, `fields` lists every field with `showFor` (`all` or the sub-categories it belongs to).

request.description:

item.name: Reassign — move an item straight to another employee

request.description:
**Permission:** reading is open to any signed-in user; this change needs `assignments`.

Takes `quantity` (default: everything the current employee holds) back from the current holder and gives it to the new employee in one step. Total stock doesn't change; history shows "Reassigned from / to". Send `employeeId` (existing employee) **or** `employeeCode` + `departmentId` (+ `employeeName` for a new ID). Inactive items can't be reassigned.
